terminationDate.description: The date on which the contract termination is to take effect. It is represented as a string in the date format.

addressTypesToCollect.description: An array indicating the types of addresses to collect. Valid values include 'BILLING_ADDRESS' and 'SHIPPING_ADDRESS'.

allTransactionsFeeName.description: The name of the fee applied to all transactions.

allTransactionsFeePercentage.description: The percentage of the fee applied to all transactions.

allowedPaymentMethods.description: An array of allowed payment methods. Valid values include 'CREDIT_OR_DEBIT_CARD', 'ACH', 'SEPA', 'BACS', 'PADS', 'AFFIRM', and 'KLARNA'.

annualContractValue.description: The annual value of the contract.

automatedTaxesEnabled.description: Indicates whether automated taxes are enabled for the contract.

city.description: The city where the address is located. It is represented as a string.

country.description: The country of the address. This is a string indicating the nation associated with the address.

countryCode.description: The code representing the country of the address. It is a string, typically following international country code standards.

state.description: The state or region of the address. This is a string that specifies the subdivision within the country.

zip.description: The postal code for the address. It is a string used for mail delivery purposes.

recurringBillingStartDate.description: The start date for recurring billing, in ISO 8601 date format.

recurringBillingTerms.description: The terms for recurring billing. Valid values include 'AUTOMATICALLY_RENEW' and 'FIXED'.

richTextDescription.description: A rich text description of the line item.

sku.description: The stock keeping unit (SKU) for this line item.

tax.description: The tax rate applied to this line item. A number.

taxAmount.description: The total tax amount for this line item. A number.

taxCategory.description: The tax category for this line item.

taxRateGroupId.description: The unique identifier for the tax rate group associated with this line item.

termInMonths.description: The term length in months for this line item. An integer.

tierAmount.description: The amount for the current pricing tier. A number.

totalDiscount.description: The total discount amount for this line item. A number.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when this line item was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

variantId.description: The unique identifier for the product variant associated with this line item.

locale.description: The locale associated with the contract.

netPaymentTerms.description: The net payment terms for the contract, represented as an integer.

paymentEnabled.description: Indicates whether payment is enabled for the contract.

paymentMethod.description: The payment method used for the contract.

sellerFirstName.description: The first name of the seller.

sellerLastName.description: The last name of the seller.

sellerPhoneNumber.description: The phone number of the seller.

startDate.description: The start date of the contract, in ISO 8601 format.

status.description: The current status of the contract. Valid values include 'DRAFT', 'ACTIVE', 'PAUSED', 'COMPLETED', and 'TERMINATED'.

storePaymentMethodAtCheckout.description: Indicates whether the payment method should be stored at checkout.

totalCollectedFees.description: The total amount of fees collected under the contract.

totalContractValue.description: The total value of the contract.

totalPaidAmount.description: The total amount paid under the contract.

schema.description: Represents an error response returned by the API when an operation fails. This component is used in various endpoints to provide detailed information about the error encountered.

example.message: Invalid input (details will vary based on the error)

context.description: Context about the error condition, provided as an object with additional properties that are arrays of strings.

correlationId.description: A unique identifier for the request. Include this value with any error reports or support tickets. It is formatted as a UUID.

errors.description: Further information about the error, represented as an array of ErrorDetail objects.

items.description: Represents detailed information about an error that occurred in the API. This component is used to provide additional context and specifics about errors, typically as part of an error response.

code.description: The status code associated with the error detail, represented as a string.

context.description: Context about the error condition, represented as an object where each key is a string and each value is an array of strings. This provides additional information about the error.

in.description: The name of the field or parameter in which the error was found. This is an optional string field.

message.description: A human readable message describing the error along with remediation steps where appropriate. This is a required field and is of type string.

subCategory.description: A specific category that contains more specific detail about the error, provided as a string.

links.description: A map of link names to associated URIs containing documentation about the error or recommended remediation steps.

message.description: A human readable message describing the error along with remediation steps where appropriate.

subCategory.description: A specific category that contains more specific detail about the error.
